subject: Uplift signal + timeboxed discount for Q3 expansion
messages:
From: Elena Torres <elena@brightlane.health>
To: naomi_feldman@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 07 Aug 2026 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Need uplift options — time-sensitive

Hi Naomi,

Quick note from BrightLane — our usage has jumped ~30% month-over-month after the new triage workflow rolled out. We need a mid-contract top-up for capacity and our procurement team wants clear pricing and a timeboxed concession so we can get a PO in this week.

What we need from you:
- Pricing for a +30% committed uplift for the remainder of our contract term (co-term to our renewal if possible)
- Any short-term discount you can make available if we sign a PO within 10 business days
- Invoice timing and simple language we can paste into the PO

Procurement timeline: PO draft ready by Mon, legal signoff by end of next week.

Thanks — Elena
Elena Torres
Head of Platform
BrightLane Health
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena@brightlane.health>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 07 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Need uplift options — time-sensitive

Hi Elena — thanks for the heads up and congrats on the rollout — great to see adoption. Short version: we can support a rapid top-up + a short, timeboxed discount. Details below and I attached a quick options spreadsheet.

Option A — Immediate top-up (no change to term)
- +30% committed capacity for remainder of current term
- 8% discount on incremental unit price
- Invoice upfront for the uplift months or net-30 (your choice)

Option B — Co-term + incentive (preferred for both sides)
- +30% committed capacity and co-term to align remaining months to next annual renewal
- 12% discount on the incremental units
- 3 months of runway credit (applied as service credit) to smooth transition
- Requires sign of PO and a short amendment within 10 business days to receive the 12% level

Attachments: uplift_pricing_options.xlsx (spreadsheet), timeboxed_discount_term.pdf (one-page summary you can send to procurement).

Ben / Marissa — looping you for quick approval on the timeboxed 12% concession + 3-month credit. If legal needs a short amendment template I can draft.

Elena, happy to jump on a 20-min call if you want to walk procurement through the language.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Director, Growth Partnerships | Redwood Inference
naomi_feldman@redwoodinference.com
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 09:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Need uplift options — time-sensitive

Naomi / Marissa — quick internal. I support Option B for BrightLane (12% + 3 months runway credit) given the expansion velocity and the upsell potential. A few notes:
- Margin on incremental is tight at 12% but acceptable if we get a co-term and a firm commit tied to next year's renewal (use the deal_id DL-2026-9873).
- Please include an explicit PO invoice schedule: 50% upfront for the uplift, remainder net-30; or bill pro-rata across remaining months if they prefer.
- I'll request a one-time exec approval for the 12% concession (copy of the numbers going to finance).

Marissa — can you triage legal/Amendment template and confirm we can apply the 3-month runway credit as a service credit line on the account?

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter
